text_block_list.text:
Tee-hee! ♪ I've got me the good stuff!
Nothing to
worry about with this lucky
charm on hand...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold up! If memory serves, there's
a
mischievous cat lurking around here. I
need to
keep this safe so it doesn't get
stolen...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: You little devil! Get back here!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Not only does Матиканэфукукитару fail to
retrieve
her charm, but she walks away
from the ordeal
completely exhausted.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
